abstract: Pancreatic cancer (PC) is among the most lethal malignancies with slower progress in overall survival and treatment options compared to other cancers. The 2025 Canadian National Pancreas Conference (NPC)-the third biennial event of its kind-was hosted by Craig's Cause Pancreatic Cancer Society and the Baker Centre for Pancreatic Cancer in November 2025 in London, Ontario, co-organized by the Canadian Association of General Surgeons (CAGS) with accreditation through the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada. The event brought together experts across healthcare disciplines as well as researchers, students, and allied professionals to discuss the latest advances in treatment and management of this complex disease. The conference featured presentations, workshops, and discussions on the current landscape of treatment and management of PC with an emphasis on the increasing significance of genomic sequencing, equitable care, and a multidisciplinary approach.
key_points_ko: 2025년 캐나다 국립 췌장 컨퍼런스는 췌장암(PC) 치료의 최신 발전 사항을 논의하기 위해 개최되었습니다.
공평한 치료와 다학제적 접근 방식이 주요 논의 주제였습니다.
summary_ko: 본 문헌은 2025년 11월 온타리오주 런던에서 개최된 제3회 캐나다 국립 췌장 컨퍼런스(NPC)의 내용을 다룹니다. Craig's Cause Pancreatic Cancer Society와 Baker Centre for Pancreatic Cancer가 주최하고 캐나다 일반외과의사회(CAGS)가 공동 조직했습니다. 이 행사에서는 의료 전문가, 연구자, 학생들이 모여 췌장암(pancreatic cancer, PC) 치료 및 관리의 최신 발전 사항을 논의했습니다. 특히 유전체 시퀀싱(genomic sequencing), 공평한 치료, 다학제적 접근의 중요성이 강조되었습니다.
title: Canadian National Pancreas Conference 2025: Recent Advances in Patient-Centred Management of Pancreatic Cancer
